name: darrow-goal-loop
description: Compile bounded engineering requests and activate host-native goals on verified routes

interface.longDescription: Prepare a bounded engineering request, compile an observable goal contract, load the selected workflow playbook and risk gate, select and apply a proportionate model and effort, and activate native goal mode with harness-verifiable workflow and route evidence.
defaultPrompt: Preflight this bounded engineering request and activate it as one host-native goal.
